meta.name: deepchem
meta.description: Molecular ML with diverse featurizers and pre-built datasets. Use for property prediction (ADMET, toxicity) with traditional ML or GNNs when you want extensive featurization options and MoleculeNet benchmarks. Best for quick experiments with pre-trained models, diverse molecular representations. For graph-first PyTorch workflows use torchdrug; for benchmark datasets use pytdc.

copy.tagline: 预测分子性质，加速化学与药物研发
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速评估大量分子的ADMET和毒性等性质
copy.tagline_en: Predict molecular properties to accelerate drug discovery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly evaluate ADMET and toxicity properties for many molecules

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 能用 DeepChem 处理化学数据：读取分子文件，把 SMILES 转成特征，用传统机器学习或图神经网络训练模型，预测溶解度、毒性等性质，也能调用 MoleculeNet 基准数据集和预训练模型做微调。
howto.when: 当你要预测分子性质（如 ADMET、毒性）、需要多种分子特征化方式，或想用 MoleculeNet 基准数据快速做实验、调用预训练模型时触发。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to load molecular data, convert SMILES into fingerprints or graphs, train ML or GNN models for property prediction (solubility, toxicity), and use MoleculeNet benchmarks or pretrained models for transfer learning.
howto.when_en: Triggered when predicting molecular properties (ADMET, toxicity), requesting diverse featurization options, or using MoleculeNet benchmarks / pretrained models for quick experiments.
